🚨 3 Mistakes That Stop Pre-Glued Lashes Lasting 5-10 Days 🚨

❌ Skipping Eye Prep
Even the best lashes won’t stick if there’s oil or makeup left behind. Always start with a clean, dry lash line.

❌ Skincare Too Close
Serums and creams are amazing for skin — not for lash glue. Keep them away from your lash line to stop breakdown.

❌ Getting Them Wet Too Soon
Water and steam in the first 24 hours will weaken the bond. Give them time to set before swimming or showering.

✨ Follow these 3 steps and your lashes can last up to 10 days - lightweight, comfortable, and totally natural-looking.

body.text:
I was spending over $3,000 a year just to keep my lashes on. 😩

Two hours at the lash tech every two weeks. No side sleeping. No eyeliner. No scrubbing.
I washed around my lashes like they were made of glass.

It wasn’t just expensive — it was exhausting.

So I tried DIY lash clusters.
They promised seven-day wear, no appointments. I was sold.

But the glue was thick and sticky, brushed right onto my lashes.
It stayed tacky — picking up dust, fuzz, and lint. 😷

I wore them overnight like you’re supposed to — and woke up with red, irritated eyes and crusty clusters out of place.

So I started pulling them off every night. Washing my eyes.
And reapplying every morning.

Ten clusters a day at $40 a box?
It was just as expensive as fills.

That’s when I thought: there has to be a better way.

I became obsessed with fixing the lash problem no one was solving.

I tried everything:
❌ Magnetic lashes (too bulky)
❌ Amazon dupes (stiff and fake)
❌ Premium brands (same overnight glue mess)

And on my smaller Asian eyes?
Most styles just looked overwhelming.

I just wanted:
💗 Lashes that looked like extensions
💗 Something I could remove at night and reuse
💗 A routine that didn’t take over my life

But it didn’t exist.

So I started building it myself.

I reached out to manufacturers all over the world. Samples poured in. My bathroom turned into a mini lab — tweezers in hand, sticky notes everywhere, bathroom light blazing.

We nailed the lash first: soft Korean PBT silk fibers, and a barely-there band that melted into my lash line.

Then came the glue.

We wanted something totally different: pre-glued lashes.
Solid glue built into the band, so the lashes could press on like stickers.

But it took dozens of rounds to get it right.
Some stung. Some slipped. Some turned gummy by noon.

Then — we got it.
A glue that held all day, peeled off clean, and didn’t irritate.

It was almost perfect.

But it had one problem — it lost tackiness after just a few wears.

The lashes were still in great shape… but the glue was done. Tossing perfectly good clusters made no sense.

That’s when the breakthrough hit:
What if the glue could be replaced — like a sticker? 😲

That one idea sparked the Lash Stickies system: peel off the old glue, and press on a fresh tab. 

Just like that, the clusters became truly reusable.

Not just twice — but 10+ times.

Navo was born.

I didn’t mean to start a brand.
I just wanted lashes that worked for my life.

But when I showed friends, they all said the same thing:
Wait — what IS this?

They had felt it too. The glue gunk. The cost. The constant maintenance.

So we launched. Sold out in a month. Restocked. Sold out again.

Navo lashes press on in minutes, hold all day, and peel off clean at night. No messy glue. No damage.

And they’ve survived everything:
🌞 38°C in Spain
❄️ -30°C in Calgary
🏎️ Go-karting, rainstorms, sweaty workouts, red-eye flights

Navo Lashes are lashes that finally fit into real life.

❌ Messy liquid glue that sticks to lash hairs and makes removal a nightmare
❌ Multi-day wear means you can’t clean your eyes properly

🚨 3 Mistakes That Stop Pre-Glued Lashes Lasting 5-10 Days 🚨

❌ Skipping Eye Prep
Even the best lashes won’t stick if there’s oil or makeup left behind. Always start with a clean, dry lash line.

❌ Skincare Too Close
Serums and creams are amazing for skin — not for lash glue. Keep them away from your lash line to stop breakdown.

❌ Getting Them Wet Too Soon
Water and steam in the first 24 hours will weaken the bond. Give them time to set before swimming or showering.

I was spending over $3,000 a year just to keep my lashes on. 😩

So I started pulling them off every night. Washing my eyes.
And reapplying every morning.

Ten clusters a day at $40 a box?
It was just as expensive as fills.

That’s when I thought: there has to be a better way.

I became obsessed with fixing the lash problem no one was solving.

❌ Amazon dupes (stiff and fake)
❌ Premium brands (same overnight glue mess)

Most styles just looked overwhelming.

💗 A routine that didn’t take over my life

Solid glue built into the band, so the lashes could press on like stickers.

Then — we got it.
A glue that held all day, peeled off clean, and didn’t irritate.

The lashes were still in great shape… but the glue was done. Tossing perfectly good clusters made no sense.

That’s when the breakthrough hit:
What if the glue could be replaced — like a sticker? 😲

That one idea sparked the Lash Stickies system: peel off the old glue, and press on a fresh tab. 

Just like that, the clusters became truly reusable.

Not just twice — but 10+ times.

Navo was born.

I didn’t mean to start a brand.
I just wanted lashes that worked for my life.
